verdict.rationale: Missive's own rules run unattended in the background. Rules can run in timed steps that wait, re-check their conditions and act, such as escalating unanswered support emails at 24, 48 and 72 hours. Rules can also create drafts, and AI rules exist. The AI-driven side is thin: AI rules get only a passing mention, and agent triage is shown only as an example use of external apps connecting through MCP. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of AI or agent-driven rule behavior (what AI rules can do autonomously), full rule trigger and action reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Rules can now run in steps over time. Each step waits, checks its own conditions, then acts on the same conversation.
Escalate unanswered support emails: label at 24 hrs, notify the lead at 48, reassign at 72.
Delays can count calendar time or business hours.
Drafts created outside the composer, by the assistant, by a rule, or through the API and MCP server, now resolve {{ user.name }} and {{ user.email }} from your organization profile
Your AI rules, saved models, and assistant conversations stay intact
